title: Harden workflow scope and build Workforce action projection
goal: Provide secure organization/department workflow scope and a normalized source-backed WorkforceActionItem projection.

in: Tasks, workflow tasks, logistics tasks, and derived exception adapters
out: Copying tasks into a new table
Writing under lib/logistics/**, which the active logistics overhaul holds (ADMIN-005/011, DB-011, WORK-007)
Creating a second task silo or writing action mutations that bypass the owning domain (CP-097)

working_set: types/workforce/actions.ts (action projection types only; WFC-005 owns the base types)
lib/workflows/** (read-only projection input per CP-097: you normalize, you do not mutate)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every action exposes source, owner, department, due date, priority, blockers, dependencies, and source URL
Mutations dispatch to the authoritative source
Workflow and logistics access is organization/department scoped
Source failures remain explicit without erasing healthy actions

progress.summary: Blocked on canonical department authority and the command read model.
next_steps: CP-103 partition: app/api/admin/workforce/actions/** and lib/workforce/actions/** are yours alone.

CP-097 is binding: mutations continue through the owning domain. lib/workflows/** and lib/logistics/** are read-only projection inputs. Any mutation you believe is missing is a handoff to the owning lane, not a new writer here.
Build the normalized WorkforceActionItem projection with explicit source and navigation target per item, and derived exceptions that resolve only when their source condition resolves.

lib/logistics/** is NOT in your working set: it is held by the active logistics overhaul (ADMIN-005, ADMIN-011, DB-011, WORK-007). Read it if a logistics source requires it and record the expansion reason in your checkpoint; do not write it.

CP-103 partition: claim only your own subtrees of app/api/admin/workforce/**. WFC-005/012/014/019 previously each claimed the whole tree, which already contains seven live routes (attendance, conflicts, conversions, health, identity-merge, payroll-exports, people).
Before authoring anything, disposition each route in your subtrees: adopt as-is, reconcile, or leave to its named owner. Do not write a parallel second implementation.
Implement source adapters and transition dispatch

handoffs: Work → Admin: WorkforceActionItem and transition contracts for WFC-015
Work → QA: derived-exception and partial-source fixtures
resume_condition: CP-103 partition: app/api/admin/workforce/actions/** and lib/workforce/actions/** are yours alone.
